content:
The Affine Plank Conjecture has remained open for 75 years, and it's finally proven for 3 planks in the plane using Astra, Fable and Lean 4.

https://zazbrown.com/research/paper/affine-plank/

This was a really cool journey that started as a side-project during my master's degree trying to brute-force the thing with a GPU and a Lipschitz bound :rolling_on_the_floor_laughing:

I hope people appreciate it.
